title: Effect of Gastric Balloon in Morbid Obesity: Prospective Study
brief_summary: The aim of this study is to compare the efficacy of gastric balloon in weight reduction among two different categories of morbidly obese people.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* morbid obesity

Exclusion Criteria:

* patient refusal
* psychological patients
* oesophageal or gastric abnormalities
